sub_sector.value: clinical diagnostics and life science research instruments and reagents; digital PCR; bioprocess chromatography

manufacturing_type.detail: Makes instruments as discrete units; reagents, controls, and chromatography media produced by batch process.

production_model.detail: Standard catalog instruments, reagents, kits and controls sold off the shelf.

product_complexity.detail: Precision instruments and regulated diagnostic assays and controls emphasizing accuracy and sensitivity.

production_role.detail: Sells finished instruments, reagents, test kits and quality controls directly to labs and researchers.

end_market_exposure.detail: Clinical diagnostics labs, life science research, biopharma bioprocessing; also food safety and education customers.

notes: Manufacturing type and production model rely on general knowledge of instruments and reagents rather than explicit statements.
